name: public_weather_om_forecast_frankfurt

wind_speed_10m_mps.description: wind speed at 10 m (requested with wind_speed_unit=ms)

shortwave_radiation_w_m2.description: shortwave solar radiation, mean of the preceding hour

wet_bulb_2m_c.description: wet-bulb temperature computed here with Stull (2011, doi:10.1175/JAMC-D-11-0143.1) from temperature_2m_c and relative_humidity_2m_pct

notes: Archived forecasts from the Open-Meteo historical-forecast API: best-match model runs, stitched from short lead times. Known only up to the issue time of each run, so usable as a short-lead covariate, not as a verified day-ahead vintage.
